title: Matching puncture marks examined by Dr Margo

tellings.quote: and they're exactly the same depth and this and the same size
One more thing: I have two small puncture marks on my skin that I can’t explain. They’re identical; a perfectly round depression with a raised dimple in the center.

plain: A former Air Force guard at a nuclear missile site, who believes he was abducted by a UFO, says he carries two small puncture marks that a doctor found to be exact copies of each other. The man, Mario Woods, tells Michels that a physician he calls Dr Margo, who examined him on St. Simons Island, Georgia, around 2019, found the marks to be "exactly the same depth and the same size". He tells it as physical evidence that something was done to him. The researcher Robert Hastings had already written about the marks. His article of September 10, 2017, about a former Air Force missile security policeman's apparent abduction at a nuclear missile site, quotes the man. "I have two small puncture marks on my skin that I can't explain," he says. "They're identical; a perfectly round depression with a raised dimple in the center." The doctor's findings come only from Woods' telling on the show.
